# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book is about drawing inference — using data, models, and computation to reason under uncertainty.

## How to use this book

Chapters combine mathematical exposition with runnable Python code. You can toggle code visibility using the **Code** button on any code block.

```{python}
#| label: fig-welcome
#| fig-cap: "A simple plot to verify the setup works."

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 200)
y = np.sin(x)

plt.plot(x, y)
plt.xlabel("x")
plt.ylabel("sin(x)")
plt.title("Hello, Quarto!")
plt.show()
```
